subject: general
question:
In the following questions, the symbols @, #, $, © and % are used with the following meaning as illustrated below:

P @ Q => P ≥ Q

P # Q => P ≤ Q

P $ Q => P P > Q

P % Q => P = Q

Statements: M © N N # O

Conclusions:

I. M © O

II. M @ O

options.text: If only conclusion I is true.
If only conclusion II is true.
Both I and II are true
Neither I nor II is true

solution:
Given Statement: M > N ≤ O

Now,

Conclusions:

(i) M > O → False (From M > N and N ≤ O, no definite relation between M and O)

(ii) M ≥ O → False (Again, no definite relation between M and O can be established)

Here, Neither conclusion I nor II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
